name: Vector buffer
description: Construct planar buffers around vector features using an explicit projected measurement CRS.

distance.description: Positive planar buffer distance in the horizontal units of the declared measurement CRS.

unit.description: Unit label that must match the projected CRS horizontal axis units.

quad_segs.description: Segments per quarter-circle used to approximate circular arcs.

cap_style.description: End-cap style for ordinary line buffers; single-sided buffers use flat ends.

mitre_limit.description: Maximum mitre ratio for mitre joins.

single_sided.description: For LineString only, a positive distance buffers the left side; end caps are flat.

preconditions: Input geometries are non-empty and valid.
Input CRS equals the projected measurement CRS.
The distance unit matches both horizontal measurement CRS axis units.
When single_sided is true, every input geometry must be a LineString; the positive distance selects the left side and produces flat end caps.
Z coordinates, when present, are ignored by this planar operation; output geometries are 2D.
validation_requirements: Every output geometry is non-empty and valid.
Every output geometry is Polygon or MultiPolygon.
Feature identifiers and properties are preserved.
